## What it is for

The **orders list** is the first page shown after signing in (marker-business-7q). It summarises the day's orders
and gives access to every function through the menu [[menu Orders › All orders]]. A new order gets the status
[[status open]].

## The screen

:::screen{capture="orders-list" title="Orders · list"}
1. **Filters**: status, customer and date; they are kept until you sign out.
2. **Order summary**: today's figures, recalculated each time the page opens.
3. **New order**: creates an order; see [the settings](#/use/settings).
:::

## Behind the screen

The list is served by the orders API, described in [the architecture](#/take-over/architecture) and limited by
[the API quotas](#/use/api-limits~quotas).
